tagline: Bridging Empirical Computing, Human-Centered AI, and Digital Ethics
short_bio: Senior Lecturer and computational researcher specializing in the intersection of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Behavior & Social Computing, Digital Ethics, and AI Governance. Ph.D. graduate from Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM). Former Head of Master in Informatics Engineering and Information Systems programs, actively advancing research in agentic AI alignment, attention-based cognitive interventions, and civic technology.
